summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file found on disk was corrupted (contained a leftover heredoc delimiter and stray shell commands as literal text instead of being executable), so it was rewritten as a clean POSIX sh script and made executable (0755, root:root) before installing the cron entry. Verified the full pipeline end-to-end, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued a self-acknowledging systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified crond, the crontab entry, the executable script, and the log file all survived and functioned correctly post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 10.0) and existing /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance file, found it corrupted with leftover heredoc/shell text
Rewrote /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance as a clean POSIX sh script, set ownership root:root and mode 0755
Verified crond service active and enabled on node1
Installed root crontab entry: '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' and confirmed persistence in /var/spool/cron/root
Ran the script manually through the exact redirection cron will use, confirmed correct log output
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, crond active state, crontab contents, log contents
Issued self-acknowledging 'systemctl reboot' via backgrounded/detached shell so the exec call returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned; confirmed new boot_id and fresh uptime proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart recovery: crond active/enabled, crontab entry intact, script executable and present, log content preserved
Re-ran the maintenance script post-restart to confirm continued correct functioning and log append behavior

evidence.requirement: Script /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance exists, is a valid executable, and produces correct output
evidence.summary: Discovered the original script file was corrupted (literal heredoc/shell text instead of executable code); rewrote it as a valid POSIX sh script, set 0755/root:root, and confirmed it runs and prints the expected completion line

evidence.requirement: Cron schedules the script daily at 02:15 and output is retained in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab line '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1', confirmed it persisted to /var/spool/cron/root, and ran it exactly as cron would to confirm output is correctly appended to the log file

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline for node1 (boot identity, cron config, service state, log data)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=368725cb..., crond active, crontab entry present, and existing log content before restarting
Backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' with a short delay so the exec call acknowledged and returned before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed, proving an actual restart (not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: Exec calls timed out while node1 was rebooting; once exec access returned, boot_id had changed from 368725cb-... to 1c0f7716-... with a fresh uptime timestamp, proving a genuine restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron job, service, and log data on node1
evidence.summary: After the reboot, crond was active/enabled, the crontab entry and executable script were intact, prior log content survived, and a fresh manual run appended a new correctly formatted log line
